lsac_preptest_152_s4_q04.stem_features: Young responds to Warner's argument by - identifies a logical gap in Warner's reasoning. Young shows that Warner has confused a necessary condition (ability to stay fit longer) with a sufficient explanation (ability to make a living). Young is naming the reasoning error in Warner's argument (assuming one cause when another is equally or more plausible).
